name: kartograph
description: Explore a person's intent in one conversation and write it down as intents/<date>-<slug>.md: goals, role, intended outcomes, non-goals, assumptions, decisions, open questions.

interface.shortDescription: Draw out what a person really wants before anything gets built
interface.longDescription: Kartograph runs one exploring conversation with you — opening the idea up, then converging on it question by question — and writes the result to intents/<date>-<slug>.md: your goals, the role you speak from, the intended outcomes, non-goals, assumptions, decisions with their reasons, and the questions still open.
defaultPrompt: Explore my intent for a new feature with kartograph-explore
I have a rough idea for a product change — help me write down what I actually want
